title: 第12章 天天晚上弄，腰都疼了
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
许红妆身段窈窕性感，该瘦的地方瘦，该胖的地方胖，紧身裙里的风光，肯定曼妙至极，就是不知道，那条黑丝，会不会也被她脱下来……

    “大壮，许小姐才来厂里没几天，之前都是她妈……”

    “后妈！”李守义替许红妆解释，却被许红妆略有些激动的打断了：“李叔，那个女人只能算是我后妈，不过以她的性格，确实做的出克扣工人工钱的事情来！”

    “今天您出事的时候，我正好不在厂里，也是她吩咐下面的人，不让任何人过来看望您的。”

    “要不是有工人偷偷联系了我，我还不知道这事！”

    许红妆越说越气，一对雪山般的高耸，再次起伏起来，仿佛随时都要撑爆紧身裙……

    李大壮这下确实消了点火气，许红妆接着说：“李叔，您还记得那女人扣过您和阿姨多少工钱吗？”

    “我俩每天干多少件活，她最后给结了多少钱，我都记工本上了，工本在家呢，得回去再算。”王守义如实道。

    “行，您回去算一下，再联系我就行，我先给您转一笔误工费和疗养费！”许红妆不但漂亮性感，还是个爽快人，当场加了李大壮的微信号，给他转了两万过去。

    “两万！？”李大壮有些惊讶。

    许红妆还以为她嫌少，漂亮的秀眉皱起，心想这小伙子不会是想狮子大开口吧：“一万误工费，一万疗养费，你觉得……”

    “挺好！”李大壮其实是没想到许红妆会给这么多，不过老爸的伤也不能白受，既然她愿意给，那自己也没道理不收。

    “既然许小姐这么爽快，那我就替我爸先收着。”顿了顿，李大壮又问了句：“许小姐最近是不是失眠挺严重的？”

    “你怎么知道？”许红妆有些惊讶，她最近确实每晚都要弄到后半夜才能睡着，但今天出门前她还仔细看了，自己天生皮肤好，并没有黑眼圈啊。

    “因为我医术好！”李大壮夸起自己来，一点也不谦虚：“我不光知道你失眠严重，我还知道，你每天晚上都要做点特殊运动……才能勉强睡着。”

    许红妆闻言瞬间脸色爆红，她确实每天都要自己在床上……反正最终都是压着被子睡着的。

    可这事儿他怎么知道的！？

    “你，你……”许红妆想问，可问了就等于承认了，那他会怎么想自己，一个空虚到夜夜无法入眠的寂寞女人？

    这也太羞人了！

    李大壮一眼看穿她的疑问和顾虑，若有所指道：“中医讲究望闻问切，你眼底透着一股常人难以发现的疲惫，就是长期睡眠不足导致的。”

    “不过你也不用多想，是人就会有欲望，漂亮女人也一样，况且人在睡不着的时候，都会想给自己找点事儿做。”李大壮往前走了一步，用只有他和许红妆才能听见的声音说：
content_en:
Xu Hongzhuang has a slim and sexy figure. She is thin where she should be thin and fat where she should be. The scenery in her tight skirt must be extremely graceful, but I don't know if she will also take off that black silk stocking...

    "Dazhuang, Miss Xu has only been in the factory for a few days. She was her mother before..."

    "Stepmother!" Li Shouyi explained for Xu Hongzhuang, but was interrupted by Xu Hongzhuang a little excitedly: "Uncle Li, that woman can only be regarded as my stepmother, but with her character, she is indeed capable of deducting workers' wages!"

    "When something happened to you today, I happened not to be in the factory. She also ordered the people below not to let anyone come to visit you."

    “If a worker hadn’t contacted me secretly, I wouldn’t have known about it!”

    The more Xu Hongzhuang talked, the angrier she became. Her pair of tall, snow-capped peaks rose and fell again, as if they were about to burst her tight skirt at any moment...

    Li Dazhuang did lose some of his anger now. Xu Hongzhuang continued: "Uncle Li, do you still remember how much wages that woman deducted from you and your aunt?"

    "How many jobs we do every day and how much money she paid in the end, I have recorded it in my workbook. The workbook is at home, so I have to calculate it when I get back." Wang Shouyi said matter-of-factly.

    "Okay, you can go back and do the math and then contact me. I will transfer you a loss of work and medical expenses first!" Xu Hongzhuang is not only beautiful and sexy, but also a cheerful person. She added Li Dazhuang's WeChat account on the spot and transferred 20,000 to him.

    "Twenty thousand!?" Li Dazhuang was a little surprised.

    Xu Hongzhuang thought she was too young, and her beautiful eyebrows furrowed, thinking that this young man probably wanted to say something like a lion: "Ten thousand lost wages, ten thousand recuperation fees, what do you think..."

    "Very good!" Li Dazhuang actually didn't expect Xu Hongzhuang to give so much, but his father's injury cannot be in vain. Since she is willing to give, there is no reason why he should not accept it.

    "Since Miss Xu is so cheerful, I will keep it for my dad first." After a pause, Li Dazhuang asked again: "Has Miss Xu suffered from severe insomnia recently?"

    "How do you know?" Xu Hongzhuang was a little surprised. She did have to wait until midnight every night to fall asleep recently, but before going out today, she took a closer look and found that she has good skin and no dark circles under her eyes.

    "Because I have good medical skills!" Li Dazhuang praised himself without being modest at all: "Not only do I know that you have severe insomnia, I also know that you have to do some special exercises every night... to barely fall asleep."

    Xu Hongzhuang's face turned red when she heard this. She did have to be in bed by herself every day... Anyway, she ended up falling asleep under the quilt.

    But how did he know this! ?

    "You, you..." Xu Hongzhuang wanted to ask, but asking would be equivalent to admitting. Then what would he think of himself, a lonely woman who was so empty that she couldn't sleep at night?

    This is too shameful!

    Li Dazhuang saw through her questions and concerns at a glance, and pointedly said: "Traditional Chinese medicine pays attention to looking, hearing, asking, and understanding. There is a fatigue in your eyes that ordinary people cannot detect, which is caused by long-term lack of sleep."

    "But you don't have to think too much. People have desires, and beautiful women do the same. Besides, when people can't sleep, they always want to find something to do for themselves." Li Dazhuang took a step forward and said in a voice that only he and Xu Hongzhuang could hear:
